items.item_text: 4-6 years Experience in fund accounting, asset management, or financial services.
4-6 years Direct experience with accounting principles and financial administration preferably in higher education and/or non-profit.
4-6 years Direct experience with financial analysis, accounting, payroll administration and reporting techniques.
4-6 years Advanced interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, and advising skills.
4-6 years Act with sound judgment, maintain strict confidentiality, and work effectively as part of a team environment and as an individual contributor.
4-6 years Ability to pay strict attention to detail and prioritize work to meet deadlines among competing demands with minimal errors.
Prior experience with financial programs a must.
Able to maintain strict confidentiality in all aspects of work.

Covered Individuals: A Covered Individual includes anyone designated as Personnel or Students under this Policy who physically access a University Facility or Program in connection with their employment, appointment, or education/training. A person accessing a Healthcare Location as a patient, or an art, athletics, entertainment, or other publicly accessible venue at a Location as a member of the public, is not a Covered Individual.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines with frequent interruptions.
Advanced knowledge of fiscal operations related to federal, state and institutional fund sources (Required proficiency)
Ability to create budget reports and summary analyses
Knowledge of financial and accounting policies and procedures.
Ability to quickly assess and annotate financial data
Advanced organizational and analytical skills with unfailing attention to detail and accuracy.
